This position requires sustained presence, intellectual curiosity, emotional maturity, and a strong commitment to continuous reflection and professional growth. * Design and offer learning experiences grounded in **child development principles** and learner interests
* Provide appropriate **scaffolding**, support, and intervention only when required — without controlling the learning process
* Review learner plans, assessments, and observations to understand each child’s needs, strengths, and challenges
* Implement and support **individual learning plans and behaviour support plans**, where applicable

title: Software Development Engineer IV
description:
Job Description
**About Porter**
----------------


Porter is building the operating system for intra\-city logistics in India. With **\~20 million orders per month**, **500K\+ daily\-active drivers**, and rapid scale ahead (**1\.5x growth expected next year**), we solve complex real\-world problems at massive scale, balancing speed, reliability, and cost efficiency in a highly operational environment.


**Role Overview**
-----------------


As an **SDE 4 at Porter**, you own a **domain or platform spanning multiple services** and set its technical direction. You’ll architect systems that hold up at Porter scale, influence priorities across teams without authority, and drive **quarter\-long technical roadmaps mapped to business KPIs**. You’ll raise the engineering bar — through design reviews, mentorship of senior and junior engineers, and active participation in hiring — and shape how the team reasons about reliability, cost, and trade\-offs.


You think from **first principles**, use **AI as a force multiplier** (and help others use it well), and ship systems that are reliable, observable, and economically sustainable at scale.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


### **Technical \& System Design**


* Architect and own **multi\-service systems and platforms** handling millions of transactions — reasoning explicitly about service contracts, failure modes across boundaries, and cross\-service observability.


* Drive **high\-level and low\-level design** across services — including build/buy/defer decisions framed by ROI and contribution\-margin.


* Perform capacity planning, back\-of\-the\-envelope calculations, and identify system bottlenecks early — at single\-service and cross\-service scope.


* Set technical direction for your domain via quarter\-long roadmaps mapped to business KPIs; sequence delivery against tech\-debt and operational risk.


* Lead engineering operations for your domain: **SLIs/SLAs, MTTR/MTTA, automated remediation** (auto\-retry, throttles, autoscaling guards), zero\-downtime migrations, and cost\-per\-transaction awareness.


### **Coding \& Execution**


* Write clean, maintainable, and testable production\-grade code.


* Apply SOLID, design patterns, and modern engineering practices fluently.


* Treat code as mentorship — strong naming, non\-obvious comments only, test coverage choices that signal intent, PR\-worthy from the first commit.


* Design for extensibility under evolving requirements; preserve interfaces as the system grows through 2–3x changes.


* Use AI to accelerate delivery, **validate its outputs critically**, and introduce AI workflows that lift the team — not just yourself.


### **Ownership \& Delivery**


* Own end\-to\-end delivery — from idea to system design to production to long\-term operation — across multiple services and quarters.


* Drive projects with high autonomy, navigate ambiguity by translating fuzzy business asks into sequenced plans with measurable outcomes, and deliver under tight timelines.


* Lead operational reviews, incident management, and system improvements for your domain — own postmortems, drive MTTR/MTTA down, and build the automation that prevents repeats.


* Run time\-boxed experiments and DevEx upgrades (faster CI, parallel builds, standardized playbooks) with measurable impact.


### **Collaboration \& Leadership**


* Align teams around shared technical direction — surface integration gaps, organize cross\-team forums, and mediate priority conflicts in Porter’s favor.


* Partner deeply with Product, Data, and Business stakeholders; turn fuzzy operational realities into clear technical trade\-offs and build/buy/defer decisions.


* Mentor engineers across grades — set clear objectives for those you mentor, give specific, behaviour\-based feedback, and surface early performance signals with measured action.


* Raise the bar in hiring — own interview debriefs, calibrate the panel, and contribute to onboarding and interview\-loop improvements.


**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------


### **Experience**


* **7\+ years of software development experience** (SDE 4 or equivalent senior IC role).


* Proven track record owning and scaling production systems end\-to\-end — across multiple services/domains and multiple quarters.


* Demonstrated experience setting technical direction for a domain or platform and influencing teams without direct authority (via design reviews, RFCs, shared infra, hiring debriefs).


* Experience working in fast\-paced, high\-ownership environments (startups or scale\-ups preferred).


### **Technical Skills**


* Strong fundamentals in **data structures, algorithms, and object\-oriented design**.


* Hands\-on experience designing systems at scale — across services/domains, not just within one — with explicit reasoning about contracts, failure modes, and cross\-service observability.


* Deep familiarity with modern backend stacks, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure; comfort making build/buy/defer decisions with ROI framing.


* Strong engineering operations chops: SLIs/SLAs, incident leadership, MTTR/MTTA improvement, capacity planning across services, and cost\-per\-transaction awareness.


### **AI \& First\-Principles Thinking**


* Use AI as a productivity force multiplier, not a crutch; introduce AI workflows that lift the broader team’s velocity.


* Strong judgment to validate AI\-generated outputs, mentor others on when (and when not) to use AI, and reason independently when AI is wrong.


* Reason from first principles on ambiguous business problems and architectural trade\-offs at a quarter horizon — not just within a single feature or sprint.


### **Leadership \& Mindset**


* Strong sense of ownership and accountability that extends to your domain’s health (Own It).


* User\-first thinking with deep understanding of business impact — comfortable making build/buy/defer trade\-offs with ROI in mind (User Obsession, Business \& Product Acumen).


* Bias for action under ambiguity — drive clarification, sequence delivery, and ship under tight timelines (Keep Moving).


* Collaborate across teams without authority — mediate priority conflicts in Porter’s favor, surface integration gaps, and align stakeholders (Collaborate to Win).


* Active in mentorship and hiring — set objectives for those you mentor, give specific behaviour\-based feedback, and contribute to hiring debriefs (People \& Talent Management).


* Resilient under pressure; raise the bar for talent, quality, and execution across the team — not just your own work.


**Why Join Porter?**
--------------------


* Own a domain/platform to build at **massive real\-world scale** — your decisions directly shape millions of orders a month.


* Solve unique logistics and operational challenges at the intersection of physical operations, marketplace dynamics, and consumer experience.


Set technical direction with autonomy — quarter\-long roadmaps, build/buy/defer decisions, and architectural calls within your domain are yours to make

description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon’s global fulfilment network enables any merchant in any of the geography ship items that you order on Amazon, to any place on earth. Amazon Logistics’ (AMZL) delivery stations (DS) receive packages from Fulfilment Centers (FCs) and Sort Centers (SCs) and sort them to route level. Drivers come into the DS and pick up the packages for their route and deliver them to Amazon’s customers. This operation is also called the “Last Mile”. An integral component in the Last Mile ecosystem are Amazon's WW delivery hubs where packages are received, sorted and prepared for on\-road delivery. Station Tech team, in Last Mile, is responsible for building scalable tools and technology for delivery hubs that scale across multiple programs and businesses including Amazon Logistics (AMZL), Global Specialty Fulfilment (GSF), to increase associate productivity, site throughput, and operational quality and scalability of our delivery network. Our primary customers are delivery station associates (our actual on\-ground rockstars who sort millions of packages a day), station managers (who manage Amazon hubs WW to ensure customer promises are met), COs (central operations team who supervise stations across regions) and on\-road delivery agents (drivers who sail through all obstacles to get your packages at your doorstep). The team build tools and process which guide our customers to reduce their cognitive load, eliminate decision points to drive standardisation, prioritise work to focus on the highest impact tasks, and take steps for correcting operational defects to reduce the impact of human error and meet our customer SLAs.  

  

UTR Tech is an organisation within Last Mile supporting all the delivery stations in the delivery network. A delivery station receives an input set of packages from upstream and performs the required set of operations and processes on the packages to ultimately get them out of the delivery stations for on\-road delivery. The associates within the delivery stations use a mobile based application called Dolphin for running the execution operations. As an SDE II on the UTR Tech team, you'll build and scale the systems powering Amazon's fastest delivery promises \- Same\-Day Delivery (SSD), Grocery, and Rush (1\-hr/3\-hr) programs across NA, EU, JP, and the Middle East. You'll own services spanning package injection, staging, sortation, and routing that keep millions of time\-critical orders on\-time, and directly move quality metrics like slot\-level DEA and defect BPS. This role blends deep technical ownership with high operational impact: your code runs in a live, sub\-hour delivery network where reliability and latency are non\-negotiable. You'll partner with product, science, and operations to launch new speed programs and expand grocery (including perishable/chill\-chain) into new regions. We're looking for an engineer who thrives on distributed\-systems challenges at scale and wants their work to be visible to customers the same day.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As an Engineer in the team, you will take part in in the architecture, design, implementation and deployment of large\-scale and complex software systems. You will get to leverage your experience and expertise to deliver innovative solutions to challenging problems. You will communicate your ideas effectively to achieve the right outcome for your team and customer. You enjoy collaborating with others to increase the effectiveness of the overall team. Your code, design, and implementation decisions should set a great example to other engineers. You will also have the opportunity to impact the technical decisions in the broader organization as well as mentor other engineers in the team.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: LDAP Software Engineer - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.** 



  

 About JumpCloud®
   


 JumpCloud® is the AI\-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.
 


  


  
 


  

**JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.** 
  





  





  

**About the Role**
  



 As a Software Engineer II on the Cloud LDAP team, you will build, scale, and operate JumpCloud’s LDAP\-as\-a\-Service: the systems that let customers authenticate and look up users and groups over LDAP against the JumpCloud directory.
 



  



 You will work with a globally distributed engineering team on high\-availability LDAP infrastructure—protocol handling, directory sync, replication, and edge serving—primarily on our Go, Python, and/or Node.js backend stacks. This role is LDAP development. You will implement and maintain LDAP protocol behavior, directory data pipelines, and the services in front of our OpenLDAP clusters, and you will use AI\-assisted development tools ( Cursor, Gemini, Claude etc) to ship high\-quality code faster.
 



  






  




**What You Will Do:** 
  
* **What You Will Do**
  

	  
	+ **LDAP platform development:**
	
	 Design, implement, test, and deploy scalable, secure services that power Cloud LDAP, including protocol proxies, sync workers, and supporting APIs.
	  
	+ **Protocol \& directory behavior:**
	
	 Own backend work for LDAP operations customers rely on—bind (including MFA\-aware bind flows), search, compare, and related directory semantics (DNs, filters, attributes, schemas, ACLs).
	  
	+ **Sync, replication, and availability:**
	
	 Contribute to how directory changes flow into LDAP (async create/update/delete), how data is replicated to regional read replicas, and how the service stays available under load and during failover.
	  
	+ **Edge \& proxy services:**
	
	 Work on the LDAP request path (load balancing, connection limits, TLS/STARTTLS, eventing/observability, password handling, and related edge protections).
	  
	+ **AI\-driven efficiency:**
	
	 Use AI coding assistants to generate code, write solid automated tests, and speed up debugging—without skipping review or operational rigor.
	  
	+ **Cloud infrastructure:**
	
	 Run containerized services with Docker and Kubernetes and operate cloud\-native components on AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, DynamoDB, and related services).
	  
	+ **Quality \& automation:**
	
	 Add automated tests for new LDAP features and legacy paths, and use CI/CD to keep quality gates in place.
	  
	+ **Collaborative engineering:**
	
	 Partner with product and senior engineers across time zones on requirements, feasibility, and thorough code reviews. Participate in on\-call for production LDAP alerts.
  

  



  




**What We’re Looking For:** 
  

**What We’re Looking For**
  

  
* **Experience:**

 3–5 years of professional software development, with a strong emphasis on backend systems, networked services, and APIs.
  
* **Core technical stack:**

 Proficiency in Go, C\+\+, Node.js, and/or Python.
  
* **LDAP \& directory foundations:**

 Solid understanding of LDAP (or a closely related directory protocol). Comfort with bind/search, DNs, filters, schemas, TLS/STARTTLS, and how applications (Linux, NAS, custom clients, Samba, and similar) consume LDAP. OpenLDAP, 389 Directory Server, Active Directory LDAP, or similar experience is a strong plus.
  
* **Distributed systems:**

 Practical experience with high\-availability services, messaging/queues, replication, or proxy/load\-balancer request paths.
  
* **Cloud \& DevOps basics:**

 Experience deploying on AWS and a working understanding of Kubernetes and/or Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Terraform).
  
* **AI tool fluent:**

 Demonstrated use of AI coding assistants to increase velocity, find bugs, and improve code quality.
  
* **Education:**

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  

  


  

  

**Nice to Have**
  

  
* Experience with OpenLDAP overlays, replication (provider/consumer), or LDAP proxy/middleware.
  
* Familiarity with directory sync from an identity source of truth, service meshes, or HAProxy/Consul\-style service discovery.
  
* Comfort debugging protocol\-level issues with tools such as ldapsearch, packet captures, or server logs.
  

  


  

  





  




  


**Where you’ll be working/Location:** 



  



 JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.
 



  


  
 


  


**You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.** 



  


  
 


  



 Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on\-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.
 



  


  
 


  


**Language:** 



  



 JumpCloud has teams in 15\+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.
 



  


  
 


  


**Why JumpCloud?** 

  
 



  



 If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS\-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  
 



  



  
 



  



 One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." \- Rajat Bhargava, CEO
 



  



  
 



  



 Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud.  Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.   
 



  



  
 



  



 JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
 



  


  
 


  



**Scam Notice:** 




  



 Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.
 



  


  
 


  



 All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. **Description**
 Amazon’s global fulfilment network enables any merchant in any of the geography ship items that you order on Amazon, to any place on earth. Amazon Logistics’ (AMZL) delivery stations (DS) receive packages from Fulfilment Centers (FCs) and Sort Centers (SCs) and sort them to route level. Drivers come into the DS and pick up the packages for their route and deliver them to Amazon’s customers. This operation is also called the “Last Mile”. An integral component in the Last Mile ecosystem are Amazon's WW delivery hubs where packages are received, sorted and prepared for on\-road delivery. Station Tech team, in Last Mile, is responsible for building scalable tools and technology for delivery hubs that scale across multiple programs and businesses including Amazon Logistics (AMZL), Global Specialty Fulfilment (GSF), to increase associate productivity, site throughput, and operational quality and scalability of our delivery network. Our primary customers are delivery station associates (our actual on\-ground rockstars who sort millions of packages a day), station managers (who manage Amazon hubs WW to ensure customer promises are met), COs (central operations team who supervise stations across regions) and on\-road delivery agents (drivers who sail through all obstacles to get your packages at your doorstep). The team build tools and process which guide our customers to reduce their cognitive load, eliminate decision points to drive standardisation, prioritise work to focus on the highest impact tasks, and take steps for correcting operational defects to reduce the impact of human error and meet our customer SLAs.
   

  

 UTR Tech is an organisation within Last Mile supporting all the delivery stations in the delivery network. A delivery station receives an input set of packages from upstream and performs the required set of operations and processes on the packages to ultimately get them out of the delivery stations for on\-road delivery. The associates within the delivery stations use a mobile based application called Dolphin for running the execution operations. As an SDE II on the UTR Tech team, you'll build and scale the systems powering Amazon's fastest delivery promises \- Same\-Day Delivery (SSD), Grocery, and Rush (1\-hr/3\-hr) programs across NA, EU, JP, and the Middle East. You'll own services spanning package injection, staging, sortation, and routing that keep millions of time\-critical orders on\-time, and directly move quality metrics like slot\-level DEA and defect BPS. You'll partner with product, science, and operations to launch new speed programs and expand grocery (including perishable/chill\-chain) into new regions. description:
**Description**
 Amazon’s global fulfilment network enables any merchant in any of the geography ship items that you order on Amazon, to any place on earth. Amazon Logistics’ (AMZL) delivery stations (DS) receive packages from Fulfilment Centers (FCs) and Sort Centers (SCs) and sort them to route level. Drivers come into the DS and pick up the packages for their route and deliver them to Amazon’s customers. This operation is also called the “Last Mile”. An integral component in the Last Mile ecosystem are Amazon's WW delivery hubs where packages are received, sorted and prepared for on\-road delivery. Station Tech team, in Last Mile, is responsible for building scalable tools and technology for delivery hubs that scale across multiple programs and businesses including Amazon Logistics (AMZL), Global Specialty Fulfilment (GSF), to increase associate productivity, site throughput, and operational quality and scalability of our delivery network. Our primary customers are delivery station associates (our actual on\-ground rockstars who sort millions of packages a day), station managers (who manage Amazon hubs WW to ensure customer promises are met), COs (central operations team who supervise stations across regions) and on\-road delivery agents (drivers who sail through all obstacles to get your packages at your doorstep). The team build tools and process which guide our customers to reduce their cognitive load, eliminate decision points to drive standardisation, prioritise work to focus on the highest impact tasks, and take steps for correcting operational defects to reduce the impact of human error and meet our customer SLAs.
   

  

 UTR Tech is an organisation within Last Mile supporting all the delivery stations in the delivery network. A delivery station receives an input set of packages from upstream and performs the required set of operations and processes on the packages to ultimately get them out of the delivery stations for on\-road delivery. The associates within the delivery stations use a mobile based application called Dolphin for running the execution operations. As an SDE II on the UTR Tech team, you'll build and scale the systems powering Amazon's fastest delivery promises \- Same\-Day Delivery (SSD), Grocery, and Rush (1\-hr/3\-hr) programs across NA, EU, JP, and the Middle East. You'll own services spanning package injection, staging, sortation, and routing that keep millions of time\-critical orders on\-time, and directly move quality metrics like slot\-level DEA and defect BPS. This role blends deep technical ownership with high operational impact: your code runs in a live, sub\-hour delivery network where reliability and latency are non\-negotiable. You'll partner with product, science, and operations to launch new speed programs and expand grocery (including perishable/chill\-chain) into new regions. We're looking for an engineer who thrives on distributed\-systems challenges at scale and wants their work to be visible to customers the same day.

 As an Engineer in the team, you will take part in in the architecture, design, implementation and deployment of large\-scale and complex software systems. You will get to leverage your experience and expertise to deliver innovative solutions to challenging problems. You will communicate your ideas effectively to achieve the right outcome for your team and customer. You enjoy collaborating with others to increase the effectiveness of the overall team.
